title: Royal regret! British king 'recognises' slavery horrors amid his Caribbean tour
summary_full: Despite the pressure, Buckingham Palace has said Charles will not issue an apology during the tour, arguing that such matters are “matters for governments to address”. The palace added that he would “not shy away from the darkest days of our past.” As monarch, Charles represents Britain abroad on the advice of the government.
